**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 sits at (indeed slightly above) the preferred playbook position:

- **19.1** — Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel per industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications.
- **19.2** — 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty running from the *later* of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services conform for the **entire subscription term** (better than the 12-month software benchmark), plus authority warranty.
- **19.3** — No malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no material functionality diminution, and no copyleft contamination of Customer source code.
- **19.4** — Remedy ladder: prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item with refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — Disclaimer is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not cut back any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty.

Acceptance mechanics at 6.1–6.2 (15 business days' testing, no deemed acceptance, refund after two failed correction cycles) provide supporting protection. Nothing to raise with the counterparty on this rule.
